🎬 Ghosts (US) (2021–Present)

Ghosts follows Samantha and Jay Arondekar, a young married couple whose lives change unexpectedly when they inherit a beautiful but aging country estate in upstate New York. Excited by the opportunity to turn the historic property into a charming bed-and-breakfast, the couple quickly discovers that their new home comes with some very unusual residents. After a near-death accident, Samantha gains the extraordinary ability to see and communicate with the ghosts who have inhabited the mansion for generations. Among them are a Revolutionary War officer, a Viking warrior, a Prohibition-era jazz singer, a 1980s scout leader, and several other spirits from different periods of American history. Each ghost has a distinctive personality, complicated past, and strong opinions about how the house should be managed. While Samantha attempts to balance the demands of her supernatural housemates with her plans for the business, Jay must navigate the chaos without being able to see the ghosts himself. As the couple renovates the property and welcomes visitors, unexpected supernatural situations create hilarious misunderstandings, emotional discoveries, and surprising friendships. Over time, Samantha learns more about the ghosts’ personal histories, unfinished business, and the relationships that continue shaping their afterlives. Combining clever comedy, heartfelt moments, supernatural adventures, and unforgettable characters, Ghosts explores friendship, love, acceptance, family, belonging, and the unexpected connections that bring people together.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Fantasy • Supernatural Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Developers: Joe Port & Joe Wiseman

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.
